title: Tom Rodriguez reveals wife’s pregnancy with second child
summary: Tom Rodriguez announced that he and his non-showbiz wife are set to welcome a new addition to their family in 2027. The Kapuso actor revealed his wife’s pregnancy during the GMA Fanverse event…

blocks.text: Tom Rodriguez announced that he and his non-showbiz wife are set to welcome a new addition to their family in 2027. The Kapuso actor revealed his wife’s pregnancy during the GMA Fanverse event last Saturday, Oct. 10. In an interview for “Balitanghali,” he said their second child is a baby boy and is due in March 2027. Rodriguez first revealed in 2024 that he has a son named Korben.
